title: Show HN: Carrier-Explode: iPhone, Pixel and Galaxy carrier settings decoded
summary: Carrier-Explode is a side project that continuously archives and decodes carrier settings for major phone brands including iPhone, Pixel, and Galaxy, providing explanations for baseband configurations that are typically opaque to end users.
problem_solved: Demystifies opaque carrier settings and baseband configurations that phone enthusiasts and developers struggle to understand or access.
why_valuable: Provides transparency and documentation for carrier settings that manufacturers and carriers keep proprietary, enabling troubleshooting and deeper understanding of mobile connectivity.
